ayahOccurrences.text: أَأَمِنْتُمْ مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: أَأَمِنْتُمْ مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَمُورُ is in the derivative form: تَمُور
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
م/و/ر   m–w–r to move briskly to and fro, to swell, to boil, to churn; high waves, dusty wind; to spill over, (of liquids) to run; (of stars) to set and rise in succession; to contradict, to contest; to pluck out.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
تَمُور tamūr 2 times and مَوْر mawr 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَمُور tamūr [imperf. of v. مَارَ māra, intrans.] to churn, to convulse, to roll, to quake, to avalanche

(67:16) أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ to make the earth swallow you up, quaking violently.

entries.label: مَوْر
entries.definitionHtml:
مَوْر mawr [v. n. used adverbially] the act of churning, convulsing, quaking

(52:9) يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا upon the Day when the sky will quake violently.
